# Zahid Rasheed

> Head of AI at Aeven (Copenhagen). Software engineering leader focused on sovereign AI, platform modernization, and engineering leadership. Berlingske Talent 100 (2024). MSc Artificial Intelligence, University of Leeds.

## Summary

Zahid Rasheed helps organizations build and adopt AI on sovereign infrastructure — systems where data, models, and inference stay within trusted boundaries. He is Associate Vice President at Aeven A/S and was previously Head of Development at TDC Brands (YouSee/Nuuday), leading large engineering teams through business, organizational, and technical transformation at national scale.

## Current role

- **Title:** Head of AI / Associate Vice President
- **Company:** Aeven A/S
- **Location:** Copenhagen, Denmark
- **Focus:** AI enablement, sovereign infrastructure, platform modernization, engineering leadership, agentic AI

## Background

- Senior Software Engineer → Head of Development at TDC Brands (YouSee/Nuuday)
- Senior Software Engineer at Kayak (Booking Holdings)
- Software engineering roles at Unwire and FlickerLab ApS
- M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence, University of Leeds (2010–2012)
- BSc Computer Science, CIIT Islamabad (2006–2010)
- Berlingske Talent 100, 2024
- Based in Denmark
